The Night Owls Speakeasy at Prismajic

The Night Owls is a mystical speakeasy cocktail bar located within Prismajic at Colorado Mills Mall in Lakewood Colorado. This intimate venue combines live music comedy poetry and other creative entertainment with expertly crafted cocktails and mocktails in a cozy judgment-free creative space.

Live Music & Entertainment

The Night Owls hosts open mic and jam nights featuring musicians comedy performers poets storytellers and other creative acts. The speakeasy welcomes all genres of music and all talent levels from seasoned professionals to first-time performers. The cozy mystical speakeasy environment encourages spontaneous collaboration and creative risk-taking.

Drinks & Atmosphere

Full cocktail bar with craft spirits mocktails and light fare. The beautiful speakeasy design creates an intimate small venue feeling ideal for both performers and audience members. Carefully curated lighting and décor establish a mystical creative atmosphere that distinguishes it from typical music venues.

Creative Space

The Night Owls is part of Prismajic a creative arts company dedicated to creating immersive experiences. This context shapes the venue's identity as a space for creativity expression and discovery. The venue functions as a gathering place for the local creative community rather than purely as a commercial music bar.
